description: This file contains step definitions for behavior-driven testing using the 'behave' framework. It defines steps for running commands, checking command results, and comparing command outputs, primarily used in automated testing scenarios.

methods.name: step_i_run_command_with_locale
methods.description: Runs a command with specified locale settings, setting environment variables for locale and encoding.

methods.name: step_i_run_command_with_encoding
methods.description: Runs a command with specified encoding.

methods.name: step_i_run_command
methods.description: Executes a command as a subprocess, collecting output and return code.

methods.name: step_i_successfully_run_command
methods.description: Runs a command and asserts it succeeds.

methods.name: step_it_should_fail_with_result
methods.description: Asserts that the last command failed with a specific return code.

methods.name: step_it_should_fail_with_returncode
methods.description: Asserts that the last command failed with a specific return code.

methods.name: step_the_command_returncode_is
methods.description: Checks that the last command's return code matches expected.

methods.name: step_the_command_returncode_is_nonzero
methods.description: Checks that the last command's return code is non-zero.

methods.name: step_it_should_pass
methods.description: Asserts that the last command succeeded.

methods.name: step_it_should_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the last command failed.

methods.name: step_it_should_pass_with
methods.description: Checks that command output contains expected text and command succeeded.

methods.name: step_it_should_fail_with
methods.description: Checks that command output contains expected text and command failed.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_contain_text
methods.description: Verifies command output contains specific text.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_not_contain_text
methods.description: Verifies command output does not contain specific text.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_contain_text_multiple_times
methods.description: Verifies command output contains specific text a number of times.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_contain_exactly_text
methods.description: Verifies command output contains exactly specified text.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_not_contain_exactly_text
methods.description: Verifies command output does not contain exactly specified text.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_contain
methods.description: Checks command output contains multiline text.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_not_contain
methods.description: Checks command output does not contain multiline text.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_contain_multiple_times
methods.description: Checks command output contains multiline text multiple times.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_contain_exactly_with_multiline_text
methods.description: Checks command output contains exactly multiline text.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_not_contain_exactly_with_multiline_text
methods.description: Checks command output does not contain exactly multiline text.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_be
methods.description: Checks command output equals expected multiline text.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_match_pattern
methods.description: Verifies command output matches a regex pattern.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_not_match_pattern
methods.description: Verifies command output does not match a regex pattern.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_match_with_multiline_text
methods.description: Verifies command output matches multiline pattern.

methods.name: step_command_output_should_not_match_with_multiline_text
methods.description: Verifies command output does not match multiline pattern.
